results.name: Nine controller families add eighteen interfaces: 188 unique entries and old parts retained
Every controller/role validates, has unassigned pins and round-trips embedded geometry
Addon and carrier templates preserve identical top-view pin numbering and coordinates
Four rotations / two flips preserve all embedded pins, holes and guards
Pico and Pico 2 each map all 40 physical contacts with 17.78 mm row separation
Nano physical contact 1 TX, 15 D12, 16 D13, 30 VIN and analog-only A6/A7
ESP DevKitC V4 has exact bank labels, 38 contacts and WROOM GPIO16/17
Feather has 16+12 contacts, correctly offset rows and no invented FREE-pin role
XIAO variants retain distinct GPIO aliases and only the 14 header contacts
Only PCB-antenna variants get default enforced copper guards; external XIAO does not
Guards are attached derived geometry and move with the part, never separate saved objects
Host and clearance display toggles never disable routing protection
Copying a part creates independent constraints; deleting it leaves no orphan
Both top and bottom manual paths reject guard crossings
Via preview rejects both-face guard area even with auto-net disabled
Imported copper under an enforced guard produces blocking DRC
Two-face fills exclude the attached guard, and active seed copper remains
Guard disable is explicit, has a required reason, and remains a warning
Malformed, oversized and unsupported constraint metadata is rejected
Schema 1/2/3 migrate without inventing host data or changing old pad geometry
Unknown embedded controller remains editable without a live library dependency
All new templates have no initial copper errors and optionally omit mechanical holes
Same-connector-face body conflicts are advisory; opposite face does not falsely collide
USB access projection overlap produces an advisory without corrupting electrical rules
Reserved contact assignment is warned, never silently joined
Pin CSV preserves named contacts and user-net IDs, with spreadsheet escaping
KiCad export flattens the current transformed guard into both copper-face keepouts
Host, overlay and pin-caption visibility do not affect Gerber / drill output
Mounted host drawings add no silkscreen until the user enables a real reference mark
All 18 variants produce readable manufacturing layers and exact plated contact count
Old Uno optional ICSP still appends without altering 32 perimeter contacts
Plane connection helper can attach Pico ground without an unnecessary via
